name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is a condition with the no-timing cue 'also', so the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is right. The next sentence opens with 'Then', which makes 'pick up the box' a required goal (hard Existence(target_picked_up)), after the key (hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up)) and after the ball move whenever it happens (hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up)); the box sentence does not itself put the ball move before the pickup, so the Response stays, and no Existence(blocker_moved) is added since it is only an if-condition. The clue lists R1 as redundant, but it is a task-stated if-rule, so it stays; no Existence on has_door_key is demanded since Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) already forces the key, matching 'Every way to finish includes: has_door_key, target_picked_up'.

texts: If the blocking ball is moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point.
The target box must eventually be picked up.
The matching door key must be taken before the target box is picked up.
Whenever the blocking ball is moved, the target box must be picked up at some later point.
